SELECT r.id, r.task_id, r.template_id, r.node_id, r.task_node_id, r.user_id, r.record_status, r.is_draft, r.submit_time, r.create_time, u.real_name AS user_name, u.emp_no AS user_emp_no, t.template_name, t.category, n.node_name FROM flow_form_record r LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON r.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN flow_template t ON r.template_id = t.id LEFT JOIN flow_template_node n ON r.node_id = n.id
ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT r.id, r.task_id, r.template_id, r.node_id, r.task_node_id, r.user_id, r.record_status, r.is_draft, r.submit_time, r.create_time, u.real_name AS user_name, u.emp_no AS user_emp_no, t.template_name, t.category, n.node_name FROM flow_form_record r LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON r.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN flow_template t ON r.template_id = t.id LEFT JOIN flow_template_node n ON r.node_id = n.id WHERE r.id = #{id}

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flow_dispatch) AS totalTasks, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flow_task_dispatch) AS totalPeriods, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT d.id FROM flow_task_dispatch d INNER JOIN flow_task t ON t.dispatch_id = d.id GROUP BY d.id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 ) r) AS runningPeriods, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flow_task_node tn INNER JOIN flow_task t ON tn.task_id = t.id WHERE tn.handler_user_id = #{userId} AND tn.submit_status = 0 AND t.status = 1) AS myTodoCount

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(submit_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM flow_form_record WHERE record_status = 1 AND submit_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(submit_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date

SELECT r.id, r.task_id AS taskId, t.task_name AS taskName, d.id AS dispatchId, d.period_name AS periodName, d.period_no AS periodNo, COALESCE(tn.node_name, n.node_name) AS nodeName, r.record_status AS recordStatus, r.is_draft AS isDraft, r.submit_time AS submitTime FROM flow_form_record r LEFT JOIN flow_task t ON r.task_id = t.id LEFT JOIN flow_task_dispatch d ON COALESCE(t.dispatch_id, t.id) = d.id LEFT JOIN flow_task_node tn ON r.task_node_id = tn.id LEFT JOIN flow_template_node n ON r.node_id = n.id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.record_status = 1 AND d.task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY r.submit_time DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flow_form_record r LEFT JOIN flow_task t ON r.task_id = t.id LEFT JOIN flow_task_dispatch d ON COALESCE(t.dispatch_id, t.id) = d.id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.record_status = 1 AND d.task_id = #{taskId}
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flow_form_record WHERE record_status = 1) AS submitTotal, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM flow_form_record WHERE record_status = 1) AS personCount
SELECT CASE t.status WHEN 1 THEN '进行中' WHEN 2 THEN '已结束' WHEN 3 THEN '已作废' ELSE '未知' END AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM flow_task t GROUP BY t.status ORDER BY t.status

SELECT CASE WHEN c.totalMembers = 0 THEN '暂无人员' WHEN c.running > 0 THEN '进行中' WHEN c.done > 0 THEN '已完成' ELSE '已作废' END AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM ( SELECT d.id, COUNT(t.id) AS totalMembers, SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS running, SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS done FROM flow_task_dispatch d LEFT JOIN flow_task t ON t.dispatch_id = d.id GROUP BY d.id ) c GROUP BY name ORDER BY value DESC, name ASC
SELECT CASE submit_status WHEN 0 THEN '待处理' WHEN 1 THEN '已完成' ELSE '其他' END AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM flow_task_node GROUP BY submit_status ORDER BY submit_status
SELECT CASE cycle_type WHEN 1 THEN '每周' WHEN 2 THEN '每月' WHEN 3 THEN '每季度' ELSE '单次下发' END AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM flow_dispatch_config GROUP BY cycle_type ORDER BY cycle_type

SELECT COALESCE(u.dept_name, CONCAT('部门#', d.dept_id)) AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM flow_task_dispatch td INNER JOIN flow_dispatch d ON d.id = td.task_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = d.creator_id WHERE d.dept_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.dept_id, u.dept_name ORDER BY value DESC, name ASC

SELECT COALESCE(u.dept_name, CONCAT('用户#', r.user_id)) AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM flow_form_record r LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.record_status = 1 GROUP BY u.dept_id, u.dept_name, r.user_id ORDER BY value DESC, name ASC

SELECT CONCAT(nc.node_count, '个节点') AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM ( SELECT t.id, COUNT(n.id) AS node_count FROM flow_template t LEFT JOIN flow_template_node n ON n.template_id = t.id GROUP BY t.id ) nc GROUP BY nc.node_count ORDER BY nc.node_count
SELECT f.field_type AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM flow_template_field f GROUP BY f.field_type ORDER BY value DESC, name ASC
